source.citation: Hodapp et al. 2019. Spatial heterogeneity in species composition constrains plant community responses to herbivory and fertilization. Dryad.

source_only_permissions: Read public repository metadata and external dataset manifests
Check exact filenames, size, version and declared checksums
Run synthetic unit tests for manifest logic
prohibited_before_new_freeze: Do not read, download, inspect, summarize, fit, or plot post-treatment species cover values
Do not score treatment-associated EOG span or prediction sign
Do not use outcome-driven sample thresholds, exclude sites, or choose horizons
Do not call the existing EOG-WF result a fourth endpoint
scientific_boundary: NPK manipulates an abiotic treatment and Fence excludes large herbivores. Neither is exact deletion of binary A or B mask. M is not measured. This is a prospective independent experimental analogue, not a full BAM causal validation.
necessary_next_gate: Obtain the exact public CSV bytes and verify repository checksum/metadata
Check site/block/plot/treatment identity and baseline Y0 against the original analysis
Choose independent site-level heldout design, the specific response estimand, model-family universe, target sign tolerance and abstention rules before opening treatment response values
Report design stop if needed variables or independently replicated sites are missing
provenance: Created after identifying the published dataset and study-level treatment categories, without inspecting original experiment CSV values.
